goal: Replace the information-heavy dashboard with a founder-first information architecture that makes one next decision visually obvious while preserving the full portfolio through progressive disclosure.
constraints: Do not remove access to underlying project state.
Default screen must avoid metric walls, filters and project-card grids.
done_when: One focus action dominates above the fold.
At most three next items show by default.
All remaining projects are progressively disclosed.
System/evidence details are hidden by default but available.
CI protects the information architecture and Pages build.
forbidden: Unbounded project cards above the fold
next_step: Merge Council PR #14 and verify the next GitHub Pages deployment serves the founder-first focus view.
